content: {"reasoning":"Two medical-necessity appeals have not resolved the missing-authorization denial, and the payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review; no claim-data error supports resubmission. CO-197 represents a contractual obligation, not established patient responsibility, so the deductible and coinsurance alone do not justify billing this denied balance. With no secondary coverage or supported remaining recovery path, the balance is uncollectible and should be written off.","action":"write_off"}
